statements.t: “The financing extends our expected cash runway into 2030 and positions us to advance YB-101 in Graves’ disease and prepare for our next steps in thyroid eye disease.

We remain focused on executing the DIRECTION-GD trial as we look ahead to topline results from the Phase 2a portion of the trial and data from GenSci’s Phase 1 multiple ascending dose trial in TED, both of which we anticipate in the second half of 2027.”
Data from GenSci’s ongoing Phase 1 multiple ascending dose (“MAD”) trial in TED are anticipated in the second half of 2027 and are expected to inform the Company’s global TED development plans.

The Company expects its cash and cash equivalents to fund operations into 2030, including through the completion of the DIRECTION-GD trial and preparatory work for the Company’s next planned TED study.
There can be no assurance that future developments affecting the Company will be those that have been anticipated.

dropped.t: “We look forward to executing across our development program and advancing our mission to bring transformative therapies to patients.”
Yarrow’s cash balance is expected to support the Company’s operations into 2028.
